description: This file defines a REST controller for a Java Spring Boot application, providing endpoints for greeting, redirecting to documentation, health checks, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for greeting, documentation redirection, health check, and info in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/docs' and redirects to the Swagger UI with correct URL.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health' and returns the application health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/api/info' and returns application information.
